shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git log --stat | head -40; ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head; node -v; npm -v
ls __agent_eval__; cat .gitignore; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "next|react" ; npm view next version 2>&1 | tail -2
npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest && npm install -D typescript @types/react @types/node @types/react-dom 2>&1 | tail -5; cat package.json
npm audit 2>&1 | head -30

npm pkg set scripts.dev="next dev" scripts.build="next build" scripts.start="next start" scripts.test="vitest run" && printf '.next/
next-env.d.ts
*.tsbuildinfo
data/
' >> .gitignore && cat .gitignore && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -15
NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25

(PORT=3100 NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npx next start -p 3100 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; curl -s localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'Nothing on the go\|No finished books yet' ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' localhost:3100/books/does-not-exist
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -1
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i playwright >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -2
node /tmp/pw/e2e.mjs 2>&1 | tail -20; echo ---; cat /workspace/data/books.json; echo ---; cat /tmp/next.log | tail -5
cd /tmp/pw && (sudo -n true 2>/dev/null && sudo npx playwright install-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -2) || echo "no sudo"
node /tmp/pw/e2e.mjs 2>&1 | tail -20; echo ---; cat /workspace/data/books.json
cat /etc/os-release | head -2; sudo -n dnf install -y nspr nss atk at-spi2-atk cups-libs libdrm libxkbcommon libXcomposite libXdamage libXfixes libXrandr mesa-libgbm pango alsa-lib 2>&1 | tail -3
node /tmp/pw/e2e.mjs 2>&1 | tail -20 | cut -c1-400; echo ---; cat /workspace/data/books.json

pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; (NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npx next start -p 3100 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; curl -s localhost:3100/books/c5a3f0a4-0450-4063-b0d4-e79a9783d896 | grep -o 'Finished [0-9]* [A-Za-z]* [0-9]*\|<script>[^<]*'; curl -s localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'Nothing on the go\|Middlemarch\|Dune' | sort -u; pkill -f "next start"

pgrep -f next-server | xargs -r kill; sleep 1; (NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npx next start -p 3100 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; curl -s localhost:3100/books/c5a3f0a4-0450-4063-b0d4-e79a9783d896 | grep -o 'Finished [0-9]* [A-Za-z]* [0-9]*\|<script>[^<]*'; curl -s localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'Nothing on the go\|Middlemarch\|Dune' | sort -u
ps aux | grep -i next | grep -v grep | cut -c1-150
NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npx next start -p 3100

sleep 3; curl -s localhost:3100/books/c5a3f0a4-0450-4063-b0d4-e79a9783d896 | grep -o 'Finished [0-9]* [A-Za-z]* [0-9]*\|<script>[^<]*'; curl -s localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'Nothing on the go\|Middlemarch\|Dune' | sort -u
kill $(ss -ltnp 'sport = :3100' | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2) ; rm -rf /workspace/data; git -C /workspace status --short
